teaser: How much to let an agent ship on its own depends on how cheap it is to undo and how mature the controls are, and both of those move.
core_idea: Whether an agent's output needs a person is a position on a spectrum with two axes, the cost of undoing it and the maturity of the controls and the record, which is why the newsroom ships on its own as a two-way door with mature controls while email in my name, a one-way door still in its explorer phase, waits for me; and both positions move as readership grows and controls mature.

nodes.label: Auto-release, arrived at
nodes.summary: Fourteen releases in a day by agents with no one-by-one approval, while every email waits for me.

nodes.label: How cheap is it to undo?
nodes.summary: The test for how much to let go: if it can be switched off with little side effect, say yes.

nodes.label: One-way and two-way doors
nodes.summary: Bezos's Type 1 and Type 2 decisions: irreversible ones slowly, reversible ones fast.

nodes.label: Rollback makes a two-way door
nodes.summary: Progressive rollouts, fast detection and safe rollback keep a release reversible.

nodes.label: Email: one-way, explorer
nodes.summary: Cannot be claimed back, damage is immediate, controls are nascent and the record is short.

nodes.label: Newsroom: two-way, villager
nodes.summary: A fix is a new version, few readers, unplaced new pieces, mature checks, a record of small changes.

nodes.label: Two axes
nodes.summary: Cost to undo across, maturity of controls and record up; the position decides how much a person holds.

nodes.label: Both axes move
nodes.summary: Readership raises the newsroom's side effects; maturing controls let email move the other way.

nodes.label: A stage before promotion
nodes.summary: New articles land in the latest list without being placed on the front page.

nodes.label: Decide by output, and revisit
nodes.summary: Not by department or by trust in the model, but by each output's position, revisited as it changes.

quotes.text: I have not yet read one and thought, I do not want that live.
quotes.why: The record that makes auto-release comfortable.

quotes.text: A change you can roll back is a two-way door; the work of a release pipeline is to keep it one.
quotes.why: Why the newsroom's pipeline is what keeps it on the cheap side of the spectrum.
